control: Human approval before official public output
notes: AI may draft; a named human authority approves publication.

control: No voter PII or nonpublic secrets in prompts
notes: Use redacted prompts and local policy before experimentation.

control: No unsupervised eligibility, legal, or ballot-status determinations
notes: Public answers must route to official deterministic authority for rights-affecting determinations.

control: Translation and accessibility review before publication
notes: Machine-aided translation must be checked against jurisdiction instructions.

control: Disclosure and review log for AI-assisted public artifacts
notes: Disclosure can be a bounded notice rather than a broad technology statement.
